Community Membership first value

Turn your membership into a stronger Franklin presence.

After activation, open Profile Center to add richer reviewed information, use member media, publish reviewed coupons, specials, sales and limited-time promotions, and share current events. These tools are designed to give local residents more ways to discover, understand and connect with your business.

Open Profile CenterMembership & billing
First value means usable visibility tools

Activation is useful when the correct verified profile can use the member tools, public results can be reviewed, and billing and support remain easy to reach.

  1. Confirm the exact terms.Franklin Navigator Community Membership is $35/year and renews annually until canceled.
  2. Connect the correct profile. Verified management access must match the actual business or organization profile.
  3. Strengthen the profile. Add richer member-provided descriptions, services, hours, customer-action links, cover/gallery media and other supported information.
  4. Publish something timely. Create a reviewed coupon, special, sale, limited-time promotion or event. Add a reviewed WebP promotional graphic or flyer when useful. Expired items stop appearing publicly.
  5. Check the public experience. Open the public profile to confirm current member content, promotions, events and reviewed media appear as intended.
Always free: claiming a profile, factual corrections, public-profile removal, legitimate basic management and the approved profile photo/logo do not require Community Membership. Promotional graphics and flyers currently support reviewed WebP images up to 4 MB; PDF promotional uploads are not supported.

Keep the focus on useful local visibility

Membership does not buy factual accuracy, ordinary unpaid Directory ranking, endorsement, leads, customers, sales or guaranteed results. It provides optional tools that can make a verified Franklin Navigator presence richer and more useful to residents.
